body_text:
Every function $f:A\to B$ has a canonical factorization
$A\twoheadrightarrow A/{\sim}\hookrightarrow B$, where $x\sim x'$
exactly when $f(x)=f(x')$. The first map sends an element to its
fiber class, and the second sends that class to its common value.
This separates the identifications made by $f$ from the inclusion
of its image in the codomain.
